{{Quote|Our institution has existed for several thousand years. It prides itself in molding young girls from Alderaan's finest families into young women whose behavior and decorum is the pride of those families.|Madam Nestor|<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>}}
The '''Crevasse City Collegium for Young Ladies''' was a [[school]] situated in [[Crevasse City (Alderaan)/Legends|Crevasse City]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] for upper-class [[Gender/Legends|girls]].

In [[12 BBY/Legends|12 BBY]], the school's governess, Madam [[Nestor]], sent a letter to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] to inform him that they had decided to expel his seven-year-old adoptive daughter, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], due to several infractions.

The collegium had existed for several thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] until it was [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed]] along with the rest of Alderaan by the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Crevasse City Collegium for Young Ladies was first mentioned in a databank entry for Princess Leia in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''.
